newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, April 29 are expected to total $1.6 billion in 30 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.3 billion in 14 sales, with a $640 million NYC Municipal Water Agency deal through J.P. Morgan Securities Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 16 sales totaling $224 million are on the schedule. A $115 million Montgomery County, Md., deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional five sales totaling $82 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
